One file, no network

This fixture exists to prove the primary delivery mode: a single self-contained document opened with xdg-open on a machine with no network.

 Answer the question below, then use Copy

After forgedoc build, this file must contain no external reference of any kind — no CDN script, no stylesheet link, no web font, no image URL.

The offline build is the one that must never break. A CDN build also ships, but it is the secondary path.

 Yes — bundle it

Roughly a megabyte, but the offline promise holds for diagrams too.
